The invention relates to a device (1) for labeling individual products (2), comprising an advancing device (3) for transporting each product (2) in a transport direction (X), a label dispensing device (4) for dispensing a label, which can be removed from a material strip (5), from a discharge point (6) in a dispensing direction (S), and a label transporting device (7) with a movable label transporting means (8) for transporting the dispensed label (5) from a transfer region (9), where the dispensed label (5) is transferred to the label transporting mean (8), to a delivery point (10), where the label (5) is applied onto the respective product (2). The label transport means (8) has a surface (11) which is brought into contact with the label (5). The aim of the invention is to simplify the labeling of individual products (2) and apply the labels (5) as precisely as possible. According to the invention, this is achieved in that the device (1) additionally has a label aligning device (12) with a roller (13) which has a roller axis (14) that is parallel to the surface (11) of the label transporting means (8) and a lateral surface (15) that is arranged circumferentially about the roller axis (14). The roller (13) is arranged such that an imaginary straight line (G) running from the discharge point (6) in the dispensing direction (S) intersects the lateral surface (15). The invention further relates to a corresponding method for labeling individual products (2).

The invention relates to a device (1) for labeling individual products (2). The device comprises an advancing device (3) for transporting each product (2) in a transport direction (X); a label-dispensing device (4) for dispensing, from a discharge point (6) in a dispensing direction (S), a label removable from a material strip (5); and a label-transporting device (7) comprising a movable label-transporting means (8) for transporting the dispensed label (5) from a transfer region (9), in which the dispensed label (5) is transferred to the label-transporting means (8), to a delivery point (10), at which the label (5) is applied to the respective product (2). The label-transporting means (8) has a surface (11) configured to contact the label (5).

The invention aims to simplify the labeling of individual products (2) while enabling the labels (5) to be applied as precisely as possible. According to the invention, this is achieved by additionally providing the device (1) with a label-aligning device (12) comprising a roller (13). The roller (13) has a roller axis (14) extending parallel to the surface (11) of the label-transporting means (8) and a lateral surface (15) extending circumferentially around the roller axis (14). The roller (13) is arranged such that an imaginary straight line (G) extending from the discharge point (6) in the dispensing direction (S) intersects the lateral surface (15).

The invention further relates to a corresponding method for labeling individual products (2).
outputs.L2:
The invention concerns an apparatus (1) for attaching labels to separate products (2). Each product (2) is conveyed along a transport direction (X) by a product-advancing unit (3). A label dispenser (4) separates a label from a material strip (5) and releases it from a discharge location (6) along a dispensing direction (S). The released label (5) is received within a transfer region (9) by a movable label-conveying element (8) of a label transport unit (7). This element (8) then carries the label (5) to an application location (10), at which the label is placed on the corresponding product (2). For this purpose, the label-conveying element (8) includes a surface (11) that contacts the label (5).

To make the labeling of individual products (2) easier while achieving the highest possible placement accuracy, the apparatus (1) is also equipped with a label-alignment unit (12). This unit includes a roller (13) having a roller axis (14) extending parallel to the contact surface (11) of the label-conveying element (8), as well as an outer circumferential surface (15) surrounding that axis (14). The position of the roller (13) is selected so that a notional straight line (G), extending from the discharge location (6) in the dispensing direction (S), passes through the roller’s circumferential surface (15). The invention also encompasses an associated process for labeling individual products (2).
outputs.L3:
The invention relates to a device for labeling individual products while the products are moving in a transport direction. The device includes a label dispensing mechanism that removes individual labels from a material strip and dispenses each label at a designated discharge point.

A movable label transporting means receives the dispensed label in a transfer region and conveys it to a delivery point, where the label is applied to the corresponding product. To ensure accurate positioning during this process, the device further includes a label aligning mechanism. This mechanism comprises a roller having an axis of rotation that extends parallel to the contact surface of the label transporting means.

The roller is arranged in the dispensing path of the label so that it guides and aligns the label as the label is transferred to the transporting means. This configuration simplifies the labeling process and improves the precision and reliability with which each label is applied to the product.
outputs.L4:
The invention relates to an apparatus and method for applying labels to individual products with improved accuracy and reduced mechanical complexity. Labels are dispensed from a label supply and transported along a defined path toward the products to be labeled. During this movement, each label is brought into contact with, or guided relative to, a roller positioned in the label-dispensing path.

The roller controls and stabilizes the label before it is transferred to the product. By correcting the label’s position and orientation during transport, the roller helps prevent skewing, lateral displacement, wrinkling, or other misalignment that could result in an inaccurately applied label. Once aligned, the label is conveyed to a transfer location and applied to the corresponding product.

Positioning the alignment roller directly in the dispensing path allows label guidance and transfer to be performed as part of a continuous operation. This arrangement reduces the need for separate alignment mechanisms, simplifies the overall construction of the labeling system, and supports reliable operation at practical production speeds. As a result, labels can be applied more consistently and precisely to individual products, improving both the appearance of the labeled products and the efficiency of the labeling process.

A movable label-transporting means defines a transport surface for receiving each dispensed label in a transfer region and transporting the label from the transfer region to a delivery point at which the label is transferred to a respective product. A label-aligning roller is arranged along the path of the label-transporting means and has a rotational axis extending parallel to the transport surface. The roller is configured to engage a label supported on the transport surface so as to correct or stabilise the position and/or orientation of the label before the label reaches the delivery point. counterfactuals.prompt: Produce an English patent abstract for a labeling apparatus and method, emphasizing the technical problem of simplifying individual-product labeling while improving label placement accuracy. Define the alignment roller by its axis, circumferential lateral surface, and spatial relationship to the label discharge point and dispensing direction.
counterfactuals.output: A labeling apparatus and method are provided for simplifying the labeling of individual products while improving label placement accuracy. The apparatus includes a label dispenser configured to dispense a label at a label discharge point in a dispensing direction, and an alignment roller having a rotational axis and a circumferential lateral surface extending around the rotational axis. The alignment roller is arranged downstream of the label discharge point in the dispensing direction, with its rotational axis transverse to the dispensing direction and its circumferential lateral surface positioned to contact and align the product and/or the dispensed label. During operation, an individual product is moved relative to the label discharge point, the label is dispensed toward the product, and the alignment roller guides the product and presses or directs the label into a predetermined position on the product. The defined spatial relationship between the alignment roller and the label discharge point reduces positional deviations and enables reliable individual-product labeling with a simplified apparatus and process.
